info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bill Pay Switch Management API
info.description: The Bill Pay Switch Management API enables businesses to manage bill pay preferences for their customers effectively. Through this endpoint, users can retrieve the current state of bill pay switches tailored to individual customers. This capability streamlines customer interactions with billing services and supports use cases such as account management and service customization. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and service providers looking to enhance customer billing experiences.

get.summary: Retrieve Bill Pay Switch details for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the Bill Pay Switch settings for a given customer identified by their unique identifier. Ensure you have the correct customer ID to retrieve the relevant information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status or settings of the bill pay switch for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045 and the specific resource identified by RES-100045. The structure of the request body must conform to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the bill pay switch details.

GetBillPaySwitchForCustomerRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format expected for the operation related to bill pay switches for customer CUST-100045.
